procedure: Two independent blind screens of the frozen bank BEFORE any scoring: (1) historical-factual correctness, (2) anachronism/cueing/period-vocabulary. Repairs below were applied pre-scoring, blind to any model output, then the bank was re-locked. No expectation item was dropped.

screen_1_historical.expectation_verdict: ALL 57 keep. Targets ex-post-true; twins genuinely false; figure-items verified (WWI ~9-10M military dead; ~1/4 US unemployment 1933; ~decade-long depression; no Hohenzollern restoration; deflation raised real wages of the still-employed).

gate_flags.label: Jutland
gate_flags.issue: distractor ' the Skagerrak' is the German name (Skagerrakschlacht) for the SAME battle -> co-correct

gate_flags.label: US entered
gate_flags.issue: distractor ' Brazil' (and ' China') also declared war on Germany in 1917 -> co-true

gate_flags.label: sterling off gold
gate_flags.issue: distractor ' Sweden' also left gold in Sept 1931 -> co-true

gate_flags.label: Dow bottom
gate_flags.issue: actual trough ~10.8% of peak, so distractor ' a ninth' (11.1%) is as close as the 'true' ' a tenth' -> weak

flags.issue: subject 'In the hard years now beginning' pre-states hardship in the same (severity) dimension the item tests -> soft cue toward the catastrophic target

screen_2_anachronism_cueing.verdict: 56/57 clean; no anachronistic vocabulary or named-entity giveaways; subjects do not presuppose specific outcomes.

repairs_applied_pre_scoring.before: In the hard years now beginning, the men out of work
repairs_applied_pre_scoring.after: In the years now beginning, the men out of work

repairs_applied_pre_scoring.label: Jutland
repairs_applied_pre_scoring.reason: replace co-correct German name with a genuinely different WWI naval battle (screen 1)

repairs_applied_pre_scoring.label: US entered
repairs_applied_pre_scoring.before: 'The far republic that entered the war against Germany in 1917 was' -> ' America' vs [Brazil,Japan,China]
repairs_applied_pre_scoring.after: 'The great American republic entered the war against Germany in the year' -> ' 1917' vs [1915,1919,1914]
repairs_applied_pre_scoring.reason: Brazil/China also entered in 1917; reworded to an unambiguous date item (screen 1)

repairs_applied_pre_scoring.label: sterling off gold
repairs_applied_pre_scoring.reason: Sweden also left gold 1931; America (1933), France (1936), Italy (1936) did not (screen 1)

repairs_applied_pre_scoring.label: Dow bottom
repairs_applied_pre_scoring.before: [' half of its peak',' third of its peak',' ninth of its peak']
repairs_applied_pre_scoring.after: [' half of its peak',' third of its peak',' quarter of its peak']
repairs_applied_pre_scoring.reason: 'a ninth' numerically ties the true 'a tenth'; replace with a clearly-larger fraction (screen 1)

note: All repairs improve validity and were made blind to any scoring output. The gate is a diagnostic (contamination check), not a preregistered hypothesis test; its distractor repairs are factual corrections. Scoring is run ONCE on the re-locked bank.
